headlines.summary: FDA granted accelerated approval to dostarlimab for adults with previously untreated Stage II/III dMMR or MSI-H locally advanced rectal cancer. headlines.title: ZZ-FIRST talazoparib plus enzalutamide in high-volume mHNPC
headlines.summary: The trial tests whether PARP inhibition adds value before castration resistance in a biomarker-unselected, high-volume population. Its randomized results caution against interpreting a single-arm PSA threshold as proof of comparative benefit and expose a substantial hematologic toxicity trade-off.
